item.title: Show HN: HeyDeacon, AI customer support agent for SaaS founders
item.summary: If you're launching a new webapp, pretty quickly you'll need a way to manage customer queries, onboarding, collate user feedback and track actions with analytics. Deacon is a drop in SDK that does that for you. You can now speak with every site visitor, collate qualitative feedback and use it to iterate and grow faster. Let me know what you think Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49262666 Points: 3 # Comments: 1
